text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, my head is throbbing...
For now, I'll cool it down with an ice pack—

text_block_list.name: Rough Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha! Are you serious?!
Come to think of it—

text_block_list.name: Rough Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Tch, watch where you're walkin', you—
Wait! Y-You're Espo...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?! Hey, you bastard!!
You got a problem with me—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hmph!
You got lucky today, so I'll let you off the hook...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City was plagued by a headache
so terrible she couldn't even bring herself to yell...
